video_title: "We Have A Great Group Of Guys, I Love Playing With Them." | LaMelo Ball Postgame Sound | 11.8.26

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on the impact of playing with Ayo Dosunmu
quotes.excerpt: Ayo is a track star. I mean, which I call him the jet. He definitely get out and run.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: LaMelo, what is it about playing with Ayo that seems so simple for you?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Ayo is a track star. I mean, which I call him the jet. He definitely get out and run, and I love people who get out and run for sure. I mean, it's easy to play with.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball says playing with Ayo Dosunmu is easy because of his speed. He calls him the jet and says he loves teammates who get out and run.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball discusses the ease of playing with teammate Ayo Dosunmu during a postgame media availability.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on the bench's contribution to the win
quotes.excerpt: We was lacking and then they came in and pushed it up, so yeah, they been giving us some good start.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: What has your bench given you night in and night out?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Tonight definitely a good start for sure. We was lacking and then they came in and pushed it up, so yeah, they been giving us some good start.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball credits the bench for providing a spark tonight when the starters were lacking.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball comments on the energy and impact provided by the bench players during the game.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on Lonzo Ball's impact on team energy
quotes.excerpt: When Lonzo is rolling, it's definitely easier. I mean, it's another point guard just getting to it.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: When Lonzo has it rolling like this, does it get everyone some extra energy and juice to see him do that?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Definitely for sure. I mean when Lonzo is rolling, it's definitely easier. I mean, it's another point guard just getting to it, so it just opens the whole floor up and makes it that much easier.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball says having Lonzo Ball rolling makes the game much easier for everyone because it opens up the whole floor.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball describes how Lonzo Ball's performance helps the team's overall energy and floor spacing.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on the importance of grinding out wins
quotes.excerpt: I think every game is important. I mean just winning and just trying to build something for the end.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Are these games just kind of important when you don't have your best stuff as a group early, just to kind of grind it out and find a win?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: I think every game is important. I mean just winning and just trying to build something for the end, you know what I'm saying? You want to set yourself up for the middle of the season, the end of the season, so obviously every game count.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball on the importance of grinding out wins: Every game counts when you are trying to build something for the end of the season.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball reflects on the importance of grinding out wins throughout the regular season.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on the necessity of a deep bench
quotes.excerpt: I feel like you always need your whole team. I mean, you know, that's why you got a bench.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: Is it the kind of night when you see like the importance of the bench, because it's going to be hard for the starters to come out of the gates hot every night?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: I feel like you always need your whole team. I mean, you know, that's why you got a bench. That's why you have all these players and everything. It's basketball.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball on the importance of a deep bench: You always need your whole team because that is why you have a bench.

structured.context: LaMelo Ball discusses the necessity of having a deep bench in the context of a long basketball season.

quotes.speaker: LaMelo Ball
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball on the team's ability to make in-game adjustments
quotes.excerpt: Just figuring it out on the fly, that's big and just basketball period.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: What does it say about the mentality of this team figuring it out on the fly rather than just relying on the staff?

text_blocks.speaker: LaMelo Ball
text_blocks.text: Pretty much what you just said, just figuring it out on the fly, that's big and just basketball period. If you could do that, that's great for your team, so we been trying to do it on the fly.

quotes.social_post: LaMelo Ball says the ability to figure things out on the fly is a major key for this team.
